email_type.instructions: Is this email an alert or a normal non-alert email?

criteria.alert: automated or system-generated notification about an incident, failure, outage, threshold breach, security event, monitoring warning, job failure, or anything needing operational attention
criteria.non_alert: normal human communication, newsletters, meeting invites, approvals, FYI updates, marketing, or general information

is_alert.instructions: Is this email a system or monitoring alert that signals a problem requiring attention?
